responsibility: This definition module declares basic fixed-buffer string manipulation routines for ARRAY OF CHAR values. It belongs to the gm2 low-level text utility layer and exports concatenation, length, copy, equality and ordering comparison, substring search, and removal of leading whitespace, providing the foundational nul-terminated string API used by scanner, environment, and diagnostic modules.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the StrLib pair: it specifies the exported low-level string operations such as concatenation, copy, comparison, substring search, and whitespace-prefix removal, leaving their array-walking implementations to the sibling module.
